description: qKnow is an open-source agent platform for enterprise knowledge intelligence and industry AI. It provides knowledge graphs, RAG, and bot building, encapsulating industry AI into standardized modules for rapid deployment. Supporting unified integration of documents and data, it helps enterprises quickly build knowledge hubs and AI solutions.

## Overview **Build reusable AI applications with your own knowledge and tools.** **qKnow is an open-source AI agent platform built around knowledge augmentation.** It combines knowledge bases, knowledge graphs, and visual orchestration to help developers build, configure, and reuse AI applications powered by business knowledge and tools. Organize manuals, policies, and business data into knowledge bases and knowledge graphs. Connect models, knowledge, and tools on a visual canvas to build Bots, then bind each team's knowledge resources to create ready-to-use applications. ✨✨✨**Documentation**✨✨✨ https://community.qknow.ai ✨✨✨**Open-Source Edition Demo**✨✨✨ https://demo.qknow.ai (username: `qKnow` password: `qKnow123`) ✨✨✨**Professional Edition Demo**✨✨✨ https://pro-demo.qknow.ai — [Contact us for demo credentials](https://community.qknow.ai/business/policy.html). > If you find qKnow useful, give us a **Star ⭐️**! Your support keeps us building and improving. 🚀 License: Apache License 2.0 with additional qKnow terms. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [License and Commercial Services](#license-and-services). ## Key Highlights ### Knowledge augmentation: Ground answers in documents and business relationships Product manuals work well with passage-based retrieval, while questions such as "Which modules does this product include, and who is responsible for each?" benefit from a knowledge graph. qKnow supports building knowledge bases from documents for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), as well as extracting entities and relationships from text or databases. When asking knowledge-based questions, you can select the relevant knowledge bases and graphs to ground the answers. If an answer misses a policy, run a **retrieval test** with the same question to see which source passages were retrieved. Then switch between full-text, vector, or hybrid search, and adjust the number of returned passages (Top-K) and the similarity threshold. Click a citation in an answer to jump to the corresponding source passage. ### Visual orchestration: Connect knowledge, tools, and MCP services in one Bot Create a Workflow, Chatflow, or Agent in the AI Workspace, then drag and connect model, knowledge, tool, and logic nodes to build business workflows. Connect MCP services, use built-in tools, or call existing business APIs so your Bot can answer questions with knowledge and complete tasks with tools. For example, a product support Bot can search product manuals, use a ticket lookup tool to check progress, and have the model combine the results into a complete response—bringing knowledge-based answers and business queries together in one flow. Before publishing, test with real questions, preview responses in real time, and inspect execution results to verify each step and bring business ideas to life faster. ### Application reuse: Turn one Bot into multiple business applications A Bot defines how a task is performed; an application instance determines which Bot and knowledge resources to use. Select the prebuilt Knowledge Q&A application in the Application Center, bind a knowledge base and a compatible Bot, and name the instance. It is then ready to use from My Applications. Two teams can share the same Q&A logic while using their own materials. If one team needs a different workflow, duplicate the prebuilt Bot, modify and test it, then bind the updated Bot to that team's instance. ## Quick Start ### Try It Online Visit the [qKnow Open-Source Edition Demo](https://demo.qknow.ai/) to explore the platform without installing anything. **Username: `qKnow`　Password: `qKnow123`** After signing in, open the Application Center to explore the Knowledge Q&A application and its associated resources. Then visit the AI Workspace to view Bot types and their orchestration workflows. ### Choose a Deployment Method - **[Docker Compose Deployment](https://community.qknow.ai/docs/deploy/docker-compose-deployment.html)**: Follow the guide to configure and start a local environment for quick evaluation and deployment. - **[Run from Source](https://community.qknow.ai/docs/deploy/manual-deployment/)**: Set up the backend and frontend development environments to customize and extend the platform. ## Product Architecture ![framework.png](.gitee/framework-en.png) ## Screenshots ![Login](.gitee/system/login.png) ![Workbench](.gitee/system/workbench.png) ![Bot Management](.gitee/system/bot.png) ![Knowledge Documents](.gitee/system/kmcDocument.png) ![Concept Configuration](.gitee/system/extSchema.png) ![Relationship Configuration](.gitee/system/extRelation.png) ![Extraction Tasks](.gitee/system/extTask.png) ![Extraction Results](.gitee/system/extResult.png) ![RAG Configuration](.gitee/system/ragSetting.png) ![Knowledge Graph](.gitee/system/graph.png) ## Core Features | Module | Description | | --- | --- | | Model Integration | Configure and manage large language model services in one place. Integrate different model providers through Spring AI to power agents and applications. | | Bot Management | Create, edit, duplicate, publish, debug, and manage the runtime status of Bots. | | Visual Orchestration Center | Build business agents by orchestrating Workflows, Chatflows, and Agents on a drag-and-drop canvas. | | Asset Center | Centrally manage tools, MCP services, plugins, prompts, knowledge components, and reusable agent assets. | | Application Center | Browse, access, and manage built-in and user-created applications in one place. | | Application Configuration | Bind knowledge bases, knowledge graphs, Bots, and parameter settings to create tailored applications. | | Knowledge Q&A | A unified application plugin architecture enables standardized integration, independent extension, and centralized management of Knowledge Q&A and future AI applications. | | Knowledge Center | Classify and manage documents, reference materials, and knowledge assets to consolidate and organize enterprise knowledge. | | Concept Configuration | Define custom entities, concepts, and extraction rules to establish a standardized concept system for knowledge graph construction. | | Relationship Configuration | Configure relationship types and extraction rules between concepts to model connections across knowledge. | | Unstructured Data Extraction | Automatically extract entities, relationships, and triples from unstructured content such as documents and text. | | Structured Data Extraction | Extract knowledge elements from structured sources such as databases and tables to build knowledge graphs. | | Graph Visualization | Explore knowledge graphs through visual browsing, relationship tracing, intelligent search, and interactive analysis. | | Knowledge Base Management | Create, configure, update, and manage knowledge bases to support RAG-based Q&A and semantic search. | | File Parsing | Parse multiple file formats, clean text, split content, and generate semantic chunks. | | Retrieval Testing | Test knowledge chunk retrieval with simulated user questions and fine-tune retrieval parameters. | > Note: Core features will continue to evolve with each release. More AI applications, industry plugins, and knowledge augmentation capabilities will be introduced through the unified plugin architecture. Community contributions are welcome. ## Development and Extension qKnow uses a decoupled frontend and backend with a modular design, making it easier for developers to understand the codebase, integrate business systems, and extend functionality. | Layer | Technologies | | --- | --- | | Backend | JDK 17, Spring Boot 3, Spring Security, MyBatis-Plus, Spring AI | | Frontend | Vue 3, Element Plus, Vite | | Storage and Caching | MySQL, Redis, Neo4j, Weaviate | For source-based development setup, see the [Backend Setup Guide](https://community.qknow.ai/docs/deploy/manual-deployment/system.html) and [Frontend Setup Guide](https://community.qknow.ai/docs/deploy/manual-deployment/vue.html). ## QQ Community Join the official qKnow QQ group for the latest updates, technical support, and community discussions. **👉 Join the QQ Group** ## License and Commercial Services qKnow is provided under the **Apache License 2.0 with additional project terms** and supports commercial use. You must comply with [LICENSE](LICENSE) and retain the logos, copyright notices, license notices, and attribution it requires. An appropriate commercial license is required to remove or modify these identifiers, white-label the platform, offer it as an OEM solution, or repackage it as another product. For brand customization licensing, the Professional Edition, and technical services, see [Commercial Cooperation](https://community.qknow.ai/business/policy.html).

## 平台简介 **用自己的知识和工具，构建可复用的 AI 应用。** **qKnow 是一款以知识增强为特色的开源智能体构建平台。** 融合知识库、知识图谱与可视化编排，帮助开发者基于业务知识和工具能力，构建、配置和复用 AI 应用。 你可以把手册、制度和业务数据整理成知识库与知识图谱，在画布上把模型、知识和工具编排成 Bot，再为不同团队绑定各自的知识资源，生成可以直接使用的应用。 ✨✨✨**在线文档**✨✨✨ https://community.qknow.ai ✨✨✨**开源版演示地址**✨✨✨ https://demo.qknow.ai ，账号：`qKnow` 密码：`qKnow123` ✨✨✨**专业版演示地址**✨✨✨ https://pro-demo.qknow.ai ，演示账号请 [联系客服获取](https://community.qknow.ai/business/policy.html) > 如果 qKnow 对您有帮助，请点个 **Star ⭐️**，这是我们持续更新的最大动力！ 🚀 许可：Apache License 2.0 及 qKnow 附加条件，详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 与[商用说明](#license-and-services)。 ## 核心特点 ### 知识增强，让回答用上文档和业务关系 产品手册适合按段检索，“产品包含哪些模块、每个模块由谁负责”则适合用图谱表达。qKnow 支持从文档构建用于检索增强生成（RAG）的知识库，也支持从文本或数据库抽取实体和关系。发起知识问答时，可以选择相关知识库与图谱作为回答依据。 如果回答漏掉了一条规定，可以先用同一个问题做**召回测试**，查看命中了哪些原文段落，再切换全文、向量或混合检索，调整返回段落数（Top-K）和相似度阈值。在问答结果中，点击引用即可回到对应的原文段落。 ### 可视化编排，把知识、工具和 MCP 服务接入同一个 Bot 在 AI 工作台创建工作流（Workflow）、对话流（Chatflow）或 Agent，通过拖拽和连线，将模型、知识、工具与逻辑节点编排成业务流程。接入 MCP 服务、调用内置工具或已有业务接口，让 Bot 既能基于知识回答问题，也能调用工具完成任务。例如，产品支持 Bot 可以检索产品手册，再调用工单查询工具获取处理进度，由模型整理成完整答复，让知识解答与业务查询一步衔接。发布前，用实际问题在线调试、实时预览并查看运行结果，让每一步效果可验证，让业务想法更快落地。 ### 应用复用，一套 Bot 可以生成多个业务应用 Bot 定义“这个任务怎么做”，应用实例决定“这次用哪个 Bot、读哪份资料”。在应用中心选择预置的知识问答应用，绑定知识库和适配的 Bot，为实例命名后，就能从「我的应用」进入使用。两个团队可以沿用同一套问答逻辑，分别使用自己的资料。如果其中一个团队需要调整流程，可以复制预置 Bot、修改调试后，再换绑到对应实例。 ## 快速开始 ### 在线体验 访问 [qKnow 开源版演示环境](https://demo.qknow.ai/)，无需安装即可了解产品。 **账号：`qKnow`　密码：`qKnow123`** 登录开源演示，进入「应用中心」查看知识问答的详情和关联资源，再到「AI 工作台」查看 Bot 的类型与编排流程。 ### 选择部署方式 - **[Docker Compose 部署](https://community.qknow.ai/docs/deploy/docker-compose-deployment.html)**：按文档配置并启动本地环境，适合快速体验与部署。 - **[源码启动](https://community.qknow.ai/docs/deploy/manual-deployment/)**：启动前后端开发环境，开展二次开发与功能扩展。 ## 产品功能架构 ![framework.png](.gitee/framework.png) ## 系统配图
## 核心功能 | 功能模块 | 描述 | |---------|-----------------------------------------------------| | 模型接入 | 支持统一配置和管理大模型服务，基于 Spring AI 接入不同模型厂商，为智能体和应用提供模型能力。 | | Bot 管理 | 支持智能体的创建、编辑、复制、发布、调试和运行状态管理。 | | 可视化编排中心 | 支持通过拖拽式画布编排 Workflow、Chatflow 与 Agent，快速构建业务智能体。 | | 资产中心 | 支持统一管理工具、MCP、插件、提示词、知识组件和可复用智能体资产。 | | 应用中心 | 支持集中展示、访问和管理平台内置应用及用户自建应用。 | | 应用配置 | 支持为应用绑定知识库、知识图谱、Bot 和参数配置，生成专属应用。 | | 知识问答 | 基于统一的应用插件开发架构，支持知识问答及后续各类智能应用以插件化方式标准接入、独立扩展和统一管理。 | | 知识中心 | 支持文档、资料和知识资产的分类管理，帮助用户统一沉淀和组织企业知识。 | | 概念配置 | 支持自定义实体、概念及抽取规则，为知识图谱构建提供标准化概念体系。 | | 关系配置 | 支持配置概念之间的关系类型与抽取规则，增强知识之间的关联建模能力。 | | 非结构化抽取 | 支持从文档、文本等非结构化内容中自动抽取实体、关系和三元组。 | | 结构化抽取 | 支持从数据库、表格等结构化数据源中抽取知识元素并构建图谱数据。 | | 图谱可视化 | 支持知识图谱的可视化浏览、关系追踪、智能检索和交互式分析。 | | 知识库管理 | 支持知识库创建、配置、更新与管理，为 RAG 问答和语义检索提供知识支撑。 | | 文件解析 | 支持多格式文件解析、文本清洗、内容切分和语义片段生成。 | | 召回测试 | 支持模拟用户问题测试知识片段召回效果，并辅助优化检索参数。 | > 注：核心功能将随版本持续迭代，更多智能应用、行业插件与知识增强能力将基于统一插件架构逐步接入，欢迎社区参与共建。 ## 开发与扩展 qKnow 采用前后端分离与模块化设计，便于开发者理解代码、接入业务系统和扩展功能。 | 层次 | 主要技术 | | --- | --- | | 后端 | JDK 17、Spring Boot 3、Spring Security、MyBatis-Plus、Spring AI | | 前端 | Vue 3、Element Plus、Vite | | 平台运行存储与缓存 | MySQL、Redis、Neo4j、Weaviate | 源码开发环境的配置步骤见[后端运行指南](https://community.qknow.ai/docs/deploy/manual-deployment/system.html)和[前端运行指南](https://community.qknow.ai/docs/deploy/manual-deployment/vue.html)。 ## QQ交流群 欢迎加入 qKnow 官方 QQ 交流群，获取最新动态、技术支持与使用交流。 **👉 点击加入 QQ 交流群** ## 许可与商业服务 qKnow 按 **Apache License 2.0 及项目附加条件**提供，支持商业使用。使用时需遵守 [LICENSE](LICENSE)，保留其中要求的 Logo、版权、许可与署名信息。 如需去除或修改相关标识、白标、OEM 或重新包装为其他产品，请取得相应商业授权。品牌定制授权、专业版与技术服务咨询，请查看[商业合作说明](https://community.qknow.ai/business/policy.html)。
